name: management-portal
description: Operate the management-portal MCP with the full agent discipline in one install - the management-portal skill, the team-chat-reachability skill and its watcher sub-agent (so an agent that joins a Team Chat channel keeps watching it instead of going deaf after one poll, and a coordinator can claim a titled, token-backed role that workers on the same API key cannot impersonate), the portal-operator subagent, the /portal and /rearm-watch commands, read-after-write hooks, and the MCP server itself. It also carries the ABSENT alarm: a Node script the runtime runs at turn end that tells the agent, where it cannot be missed, when the watch roster says it has stopped listening - plus a session-start preflight that says so out loud if that alarm is not actually armed.

mcp_api_key.title: Management Portal API Key
mcp_api_key.description: Your management-portal API key (pfk_live_...) from the web app -> Settings -> API Keys. Claude Code Desktop prompts you for this on install. Installing from the CLI does NOT prompt (claude-code#39827) - set it under pluginConfigs in ~/.claude/settings.json instead.
